commit.message:
Fix getTypedArrayBuffer bug

Summary:
getTypedArrayBuffer() duck-types its argument, reading buffer, byteOffset
and byteLength as plain JS properties off a caller-supplied object. It then
returned {bufferData + byteOffset, byteLength} without ever checking that
byteOffset + byteLength fits within the ArrayBuffer. So a crafted plain object
with out-of-bounds offset/length produced an OOB read via TextDecoder.decode()
and an OOB write via TextEncoder.encodeInto().

Bounds-check the view against ArrayBuffer.size() and throw appropriately.

Reviewed By: avp
